title: The Glass City
author: Barış Kısır
premise: In the Glass City, every surface is a screen and every screen is a witness. Hacker Maren Kai, who has lived her life off the glass, is hired to steal a memory from the city\'s archive — and finds the memory is her own, recorded before she was born. The Glass City remembers everything except who erased her.
